material.acceptance_criteria: mod-on step prints the three lines; default step prints tick line only; ci-status success on final sha
material.description: The mod-on host (cargo run --features mod) instantiates the default wasm32 component, which is built without the mod runtime (rust/crates/wasip2/src/lib.rs:88-91 returns Err on mod-load), so the mod-on step fails before printing any mod line. Witnessing the mod through the native host requires host.rs to drive mod-host::ModHost natively (ModHost::new, load_source, advance, sim().fire_trigger, sim().catalog(), state_hash), plus a test mod that changes state for the hash comparison. Decision needed: native-ModHost path in host.rs, or keep the component path and drop the mod-on witness. Receipt: /workspace/oscraft/.gm/receipts/gap-wasip2-sim-surface/01-orient.md
material.subject: wasip2 mod-on host cannot reach the mod surface through the mod-less component
